description: Map reported MMP13 variants onto UniProt P45452 domain architecture and test whether dominant variants cluster in the propeptide/cysteine-switch region
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

# MMP13 (UniProt P45452) domain architecture (preproprotein numbering, 471 aa)
domains = [
    ("Signal peptide", 1, 19, "#cccccc"),
    ("Propeptide (latency)", 20, 103, "#8ecae6"),
    ("Catalytic domain", 104, 268, "#ffb703"),
    ("Hinge", 269, 278, "#dddddd"),
    ("Hemopexin-like domain", 279, 471, "#90be6d"),
]
# Key functional motifs
cys_switch = (92, 99, "PRCGVPD cysteine switch (Cys97)")   # keeps zymogen latent
zinc_motif = (222, 232, "HEXGHXXGXXH catalytic Zn2+ motif")

# Reported disease variants (aa position, label, inheritance)
variants = [
    (56,  "F56S",  "AD", "16167086"),
    (71,  "M71T",  "AD", "30439533"),
    (73,  "S73P",  "AD", "42069302"),
    (109, "R109*", "AR", "24781753"),
    (207, "W207G", "AR", "24648384"),
]

def which_domain(pos):
    for name,s,e,_ in domains:
        if s<=pos<=e: return name
    return "?"

print("Variant  Pos  Domain                    Inheritance")
for pos,lab,inh,pmid in variants:
    print(f"{lab:7} {pos:4}  {which_domain(pos):24}  {inh}")

# Cluster test: are the 3 dominant variants inside the propeptide (20-103)?
dom_ad = [p for p,l,i,_ in variants if i=="AD"]
print("\nDominant variant positions:", dom_ad,
      "-> all within propeptide 20-103:", all(20<=p<=103 for p in dom_ad))
print("Dominant variants span residues", min(dom_ad),"-",max(dom_ad),
      f"({max(dom_ad)-min(dom_ad)} aa window) near cysteine switch Cys97")
print("Recessive variants: R109 (start of catalytic domain, LOF nonsense) and W207 (catalytic, Ca2+/Zn2+ region)")

# Draw the domain map
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12,2.6))
for name,s,e,c in domains:
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((s,0),e-s,1,facecolor=c,edgecolor="black"))
    ax.text((s+e)/2,0.5,name,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7,wrap=True)
# motifs
for (s,e,txt),col in [(cys_switch,"red"),(zinc_motif,"purple")]:
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((s,0),e-s,1,facecolor="none",edgecolor=col,lw=2,ls="--"))
for pos,lab,inh,pmid in variants:
    col = "darkred" if inh=="AD" else "navy"
    ax.plot([pos,pos],[1.02,1.35],color=col,lw=1.5)
    ax.text(pos,1.4,lab,ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=8,color=col,rotation=45)
ax.set_xlim(0,480); ax.set_ylim(0,2.1); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("MMP13 residue (UniProt P45452, 471 aa)")
ax.set_title("MMP13 disease variants: dominant (dark red) cluster in propeptide near Cys-switch; recessive (navy) hit catalytic domain")
handles=[mpatches.Patch(color="darkred",label="Autosomal dominant (MANDP1/SEMD-MO)"),
         mpatches.Patch(color="navy",label="Autosomal recessive (Spahr/MDST)"),
         mpatches.Patch(edgecolor="red",facecolor="none",label="Cysteine switch"),
         mpatches.Patch(edgecolor="purple",facecolor="none",label="Zn2+ catalytic motif")]
ax.legend(handles=handles,loc="upper right",fontsize=6,ncol=2)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("mmp13_variant_map.png",dpi=130)
print("\nSaved domain map figure.")
